summary.text: Paul Waggoner is a Republican member of the Kansas House of Representatives representing District 104 (Reno County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the House since 2019.
Paul Waggoner is listed as a vice chair of the Elections Committee.

paragraphs.text: Paul Waggoner is listed as a member of the Elections Committee, the Federal and State Affairs Committee, the Higher Education Budget Committee and the Insurance Committee.
The Legislature lists Paul Waggoner's occupation as Manager, Waggoners, Inc..
The page names Debra Waggoner as Paul Waggoner's spouse.
